user.title: Skylight Family Calendar
user.description:
**Prerequisite check**

{plus_status}

This wizard creates optional Local Calendars and a **Family Calendar** dashboard in the **original Skylight look** (person pills, clock, Add Event, view selector) using **{plus}** plus Bubble / Config Template / card-mod / Better Moment.

How many family members?

member.title: Person {n} of {total}
member.description: Pick an existing calendar, or leave it empty and enable **Create Local Calendar if missing** so the wizard creates one named after this person.

shared.title: Shared calendars & weather
shared.description: Optional shared calendars. Holidays usually come from Settings → Devices & services → Holiday.

options.title: Finish
options.description:
Creates calendars (only if missing) and installs the original Skylight-look Family Calendar dashboard.

**Frontend (HACS):** Week Planner Card Plus, Bubble Card, Config Template Card, card-mod, Better Moment Card, Weather Card. Then hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).

If anything looks wrong later: Developer Tools → Services → `skylight_calendar.fix_setup`.

init.title: Skylight options
init.description: Update shared entities or re-run calendar/dashboard provisioning on Save (reload). Stuck? Call `skylight_calendar.fix_setup`.

missing_week_planner_plus.title: Week Planner Card Plus is not installed
missing_week_planner_plus.description:
The Family Calendar dashboard needs **Week Planner Card Plus** (HACS → Frontend).

1. HACS → Frontend → Download **Week Planner Card Plus** (`randrcomputers/week-planner-card-plus`)
2. Restart Home Assistant
3. Hard-refresh the browser (Ctrl+F5)
4. Call service `skylight_calendar.fix_setup`

Then check `sensor.skylight_setup_status` — it should become **ready**.

plus_resource_not_registered.title: Week Planner Card Plus needs a Lovelace resource
plus_resource_not_registered.description:
The Plus JavaScript file is on disk, but Lovelace has no module resource for it.

Tap **Fix this issue** to register it automatically, or add it manually under Settings → Dashboards → ⋮ → Resources.

Then hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).

missing_skylight_look_cards.title: Skylight look cards are missing

confirm.title: Register Week Planner Card Plus
confirm.description: This will add the Plus card as a Lovelace JavaScript module resource so the Family Calendar dashboard can load.

abort.still_missing: Could not register the resource. Install Week Planner Card Plus via HACS (Frontend), restart HA, then try again or call skylight_calendar.fix_setup.
